title: Replace AI generation with template selection in bulk upload and add bulk delete capability to product management

requirements.text: Remove the 'Generate AI Description' button from the BulkProductUpload component (frontend/src/components/BulkProductUpload.tsx) entirely, eliminating the AI description generation functionality from the bulk upload flow

quotes: Swap ai generation for use template function

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Generate AI Description' button is no longer visible in the bulk upload interface
No AI description generation logic is triggered during bulk upload
The description field remains editable but uses only template-based pre-population

requirements.text: Update the BulkProductUpload component to automatically populate the description field for each product using the selected description template from the dropdown selector, without requiring any additional button click or AI generation step

quotes: Swap ai generation for use template function

acceptanceCriteria: When a template is selected from the dropdown, all product description fields are immediately populated with the template content
The description field remains manually editable after template population
Template selection works seamlessly with the existing auto-copy functionality when enabled

requirements.text: Add checkbox selection controls to each row in the ProductManagementTable component (frontend/src/components/ProductManagementTable.tsx) allowing the admin to select multiple products for bulk operations
acceptanceCriteria: Each product row displays a checkbox in the first column
A 'select all' checkbox in the table header allows selecting/deselecting all products at once
Selected rows are visually distinguished (e.g., highlighted background)
The selection state persists across inline edits but clears after bulk delete operation

requirements.text: Add a 'Delete Selected' button above or below the ProductManagementTable that becomes enabled when one or more products are selected via checkboxes, and displays a confirmation dialog before deleting multiple products
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Delete Selected' button is disabled when no products are selected
The button shows the count of selected products (e.g., 'Delete Selected (3)')
Clicking the button displays a confirmation dialog asking 'Are you sure you want to delete X products?'
After confirmation, all selected products are deleted via backend calls
A success toast notification displays the number of products deleted
The table refreshes to remove deleted products and clears all selections

requirements.text: Create a React Query mutation hook useBulkDeleteProducts in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that accepts an array of product IDs and calls the backend deleteProduct method sequentially or in parallel for each ID, with proper error handling and cache invalidation
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation hook accepts an array of product ID strings
All delete operations are executed and their results aggregated
On success, the products query cache is invalidated to refresh the product list
Errors during bulk delete are captured and reported to the user
The hook returns loading state and error information for UI feedback

constraints: Do not modify the existing description template management system in the Dashboard page
Preserve the existing dropdown selector for choosing templates in BulkProductUpload
Use the existing backend deleteProduct method; do not create a new bulk delete backend method
Maintain the current auto-copy functionality that includes description field when enabled
Do not change the ProductManagementTable inline editing functionality
nonGoals: Adding new AI generation features or alternative AI integration methods
Creating a dedicated bulk delete backend endpoint (use existing deleteProduct per item)
Adding undo/restore functionality for deleted products
Implementing advanced selection features like range selection or filter-based selection
